rationale: Only needed if this fork publishes its OWN signed release packages. Sign-Release.ps1 validates the private key against the built-in public key, so a self-signed package requires replacing this constant.
risk: Enabling this patch breaks compatibility with upstream-signed releases and the built-in one-click updater (ApiUrl still points upstream). It also creates a recurring rebase conflict whenever upstream edits UpdateValidation.cs. Keep it disabled unless you also take over the entire release channel.
